Summarise Class Sizes and Percent of School Population

Source: R/school_summary.R
summarise_class_sizes.Rd

Groups a class list by one or more establishment and class identifiers to calculate:

  • The number of students in each class.

  • The total number of students across classes in each school.

  • The percentage of the school's students belonging to each class.

Column names are resolved using the package's configurable column-name system. Multiple establishment and class grouping variables are supported.

Usage

summarise_class_sizes(
  class_list,
  establishment_cols = c("est_id", "est_wonde_name"),
  class_cols = c("class_name", "c_wonde_name"),
  unique_id_col = NULL
)

Arguments

class_list

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

establishment_cols

Character vector of establishment identifiers. Defaults to `c("est_id", "est_wonde_name")`. All available columns are used for grouping.

class_cols

Character vector of class identifiers. Defaults to `c("class_name", "c_wonde_name")`. All available columns are used for grouping.

unique_id_col

Optional student identifier column. Accepts an internal key, configured name or another column present in the data. If NULL, each row counts as one student. If specified but unavailable, row counts are used.

Value

A tibble containing the selected establishment and class identifiers, followed by:

STUDENTS_IN_CLASS

Number of students in the class.

TOTAL_STUDENTS_IN_SCHOOL

Sum of class-level student counts for the establishment.

PERCENT_OF_SCHOOL

Percentage of the establishment's student counts belonging to the class.

All returned columns use uppercase names with underscore separators.

Details

Both internal and configured column names are supported in `establishment_cols`, `class_cols` and `unique_id_col`.

Missing grouping columns are skipped, provided at least one establishment and one class identifier remain.

If a unique identifier is supplied, distinct values are counted within each class, including NA as one distinct value, consistent with the original function.

Students appearing in multiple classes contribute separately to each class's count.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarise_class_sizes(class_list_df)

summarise_class_sizes(
  class_list_df,
  unique_id_col = "ome_id"
)

summarise_class_sizes(
  class_list_df,
  establishment_cols = c("est_id", "est_wonde_name"),
  class_cols = c("class_name", "c_wonde_name")
)
} # }
